Messages.Author: Vezintroll.
Messages.Body:
Hello,

A blood brother (for example Agi) playing redistribution gains 1 Blood and I move from another vampire 3 blood to Agi.

Name: Redistribution
[LoB:C]
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Sanguinus
+1 stealth action.
[san] This acting vampire gains a blood. Then move any amount of blood and equipment among the Blood Brothers in this circle.
[SAN] As above, and unlock this acting vampire.

If Agi plays Slake the thirst at superior, how many blood gains a second Blood Brother? 1 or 4?

Name: Slake the Thirst
[HttB:C]
Cardtype: Action Modifier/Combat
Discipline: Sanguinus
[san] [COMBAT] Only usable when this vampire gains blood. Choose another ready Blood Brother of the same circle. That vampire gains the same amount of blood from the bank.
[SAN] [ACTION MODIFIER] As above, but usable as an action modifier.

Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
Pretty sure its only 1 blood, since only one blood is "gained" from redistribution, the rest is just moved around. But I'm not the authority here.

Smoking craters tell no tales.
—Tex talks Battletech

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Quoting LSJ:

You can gain 1 blood if you play it when "This acting vampire
gains a blood". Or you can play it when you "move any amount of blood
and equipment" to gain 3 (in our case)

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: You can even use it with Coagulated Entity to give someone the amount of blood you moved from other vampires to the acting one (assuming it ever goes unblocked)

Messages.Author: PetriWessman
Messages.Body: Huh. Did not realize it also counted transferred blood (separately). Good to know, opens up some fun options I did not realize existed
